notes: Raw printed text only. Mapping to effects happens later (PLAN T2.1/T2.2).
number is the printed card number (n/10). The extracted file order is not the printed order: cards are listed by printed number.
orientation: 'inverted' = printed upside down on the card (secrets, R-15.82, and some assets).

variants: a section without reputation subsections has a single variant with condition null. 'flavor' is the italic text; 'text' is the rules text. Several printed paragraphs are one string separated by '\n'.
A variant may carry its own 'secret' and 'orientation' when the secret box sits under a reputation condition.
Die icons: solid starburst = {HIT}, outlined spiky starburst = {CRIT}, eye = {FOCUS}.
Embedded assets keep the printed trait in 'traits' (ILLEGAL -> illegal).
The second section of every card is Takodana; the first is The Ring of Kafrene.
Errata: 'errata' sits on the section it refers to; the printed text is kept as is (R-24.4 adds a discard instruction that the printed card lacks).

variants.flavor: An elite member of the Hutt Cartel is looking for investors in his next venture.
variants.text: You may spend {CREDITS}12,000 to gain 1 fame and 1 Hutt reputation. If you are not the most famous player, you may barter to pay for this.

variants.flavor: “Imperials have been sniffing around the system. You better not have brought them here.”
variants.text:
You may lose up to 2 Imperial reputation.
Then, if you have {REP_POS} or {REP_NEU} Imperial reputation, your character suffers 2 damage. If you have {REP_NEG} Imperial reputation, resolve another Takodana encounter card.

variants.flavor: A gang leader is looking for some new weaponry.
variants.text: You may discard 1 of your gear or mods to gain credits equal to twice its cost. If you have no gear or mods, you may buy the top card of the {DECK_GEAR} market deck.

variants.flavor: The Gamorrean snorts as you sit down at his table. It shouldn’t be tough to convince him to help you.
variants.text: You may test Influence. If you pass, gain the crew below.

asset.name: Gamorrean Mercenary
text: During ground combat, your opponent rolls 1 fewer die.

variants.flavor: “Cloaking devices are hard to come by, not to mention expensive.” The salesman smiles.
variants.text: You may spend {CREDITS}3,000 to gain the mod below.

variants.flavor: At Maz’s castle, you can find nearly anyone.
variants.text: Move a contact from any planet to an empty contact space on your planet. If there are no empty contact spaces, exchange that contact with a contact on your planet.

asset.name: Cloaking Device
text: After your opponent rolls dice during a ship combat, you may discard this card to cancel all of their {HIT} results.

variants.flavor: You find a Bith musician in the posh part of town. She claims to be famous in this area of the galaxy and offers to write a song detailing your exploits.
variants.text:
If you are not the most famous player, you may spend {CREDITS}8,000 to gain 1 fame. You may barter to pay for this.
If you are the most famous player, you may spend {CREDITS}15,000 to gain 1 fame.

variants.flavor: The roar of an engine fills your ears as a new ship lands outside of the castle grounds.
variants.text:
Move a facedown contact token from any planet to an empty contact space on your planet. If there are no empty contact spaces, exchange that contact with a contact on your planet.
Then you may encounter a contact on your planet.

variants.flavor: “You want to do WHAT to their ship? Okay, I think I have something that fits the bill.”
variants.text: You may spend {CREDITS}1,000 to gain the mod below.

variants.flavor: Over drinks at the cantina, you hear personal details of the most infamous characters in the galaxy. Blackmail fodder.
variants.text: Action: Discard this card to take 1 crew from a player in your space.

asset.name: Seismic Charge
text: After you roll dice during ship combat, you may discard this card to add 2 {HIT}.

variants.flavor: “You lookin’ for some special modifications?”
variants.text: Reveal the top 3 cards of the {DECK_GEAR} market deck. You may buy 1 revealed mod with a discount of {CREDITS}1,000. Then shuffle the deck.

variants.flavor: “Ready to blow something up?” The Dug licks his lips as he snaps a new sight onto his blaster.
variants.text: You may spend {CREDITS}2,000 to gain the crew below.

asset.name: Weapon Specialist
text: One of your gear slots can hold 2 cards instead of 1.

variants.flavor: A gang of street urchins tries to pick your pockets. Maybe you can help them escape a life of crime.
variants.text:
Test Stealth. If you fail, lose {CREDITS}1,000.
If you pass, you may lose 1 Syndicate reputation and spend {CREDITS}7,000 to gain 1 fame.

variants.flavor: The codebreaker claims to be Maz’s friend.
variants.text: You may spend {CREDITS}2,000 to gain the crew below.

asset.name: Codebreaker
text: When you move into a patrol’s space, you do not have to end your movement if you have {REP_NEU} reputation with that patrol.

variants.flavor: A medical facility is raising funds to update its equipment. If you’re generous enough, they’ll name a medical wing after you.
variants.text: Recover all damage on your character. Then, if you are not the most famous player, you may spend {CREDITS}8,000 to gain 1 fame. Otherwise, you may spend {CREDITS}16,000 to gain 1 fame.

variants.flavor: “Are you a bounty hunter?” ME-8D9 asks. “It doesn’t matter I suppose, but if you need information, I know someone who can help.”
variants.text:
For each {REP_POS} reputation you have, you may secretly look at 1 contact on a planet of that faction.
If you do not have {REP_POS} reputation with any faction, you may spend {CREDITS}3,000 to gain 1 reputation with any faction.

variants.flavor: “You afraid your ship’s gonna blow? You just need an escape plan.”
variants.text: You may spend {CREDITS}1,000 to gain the mod below.

variants.flavor: You learn the subtle art of manipulation.
variants.text: Action: Choose 2 facedown contact tokens on different planets. Secretly look at those tokens, and then you may exchange them.

asset.name: Escape Pod
text: When you would become defeated during a ship combat, you may discard this card to move directly to the nearest planet and recover 1 damage from your ship instead.

variants.flavor: “You’re a liar!” the Besalisk yells, nearly knocking your drink over with his angry fist. Maybe a few credits will make him believe your claims.
variants.text: You may spend {CREDITS}4,000 to complete your personal goal or ship goal (gaining fame as normal).

variants.flavor: “If you’re a friend of Maz, you’re a friend of mine,” the droid says. “What’s the job?”
variants.text: If you have the “Maz Kanata” crew, you may gain the crew below. Otherwise, you may spend {CREDITS}1,000 to gain the crew below.

asset.name: GA-97 {DROID}
text: Action: Spend {CREDITS}1,000 to secretly look at the top card of any encounter deck. Then place that card on the top or bottom of that deck.
